readings: q[3] is the most significant bit (count 1 -> q=4'b0001, count 9 -> q=4'b1001)
q[0] is the most significant bit (count 1 -> q=4'b1000, count 9 -> q=4'b1001)
q is initialized to 0 at power-up (e.g., via initial block or FPGA default)
q is unknown/X at power-up and remains so until reset is asserted
If q becomes 10-15, it wraps to 0 on the next clock (treats as modulo-10)
If q becomes 10-15, it continues binary counting (e.g., 10->11) until reset
Counter increments on the first clock edge after reset goes low (q=1 immediately after that edge)
Counter holds at 0 for one extra cycle after reset goes low (q remains 0 on first edge, then increments)
